title: Palindrome check
statement: Write a function `isPalindrome(text)` that returns `true` if the text reads the same forwards and backwards, and `false` otherwise. Ignore uppercase versus lowercase, and ignore spaces. For example, `'Never odd or even'` is a palindrome. An empty string counts as a palindrome.
fallbackHints: If you could flip the text around, how would you decide whether anything changed?
Compare the text with its own reverse. Before comparing, make the text consistent so that capitals and spaces cannot cause a difference.

Strings do not have a reverse method of their own, but arrays do. Think about how to turn a string into an array of characters and back. Clean the text first, then compare the cleaned version with the flipped version.
